Our Approach

Durability and Beauty:
The Best of Both Worlds

When it comes to exterior painting, it’s about more than just looks. Your home’s exterior faces constant exposure to the sun, wind, and rain, so it’s crucial to use paints and finishes that can withstand these elements. At Paintrix Inc., we use only the highest quality materials to ensure that your home looks great and stays protected for years to come.
We take the time to properly prepare every surface, including pressure washing, scraping, and priming where needed, so that the paint adheres properly and lasts longer. This thorough preparation is a key part of our process, ensuring your exterior paint job stands the test of time.

Our Services

Exterior Painting Services

We combine our decades of experience with a focus on quality, ensuring that your exterior paint job is both beautiful and long-lasting. Our customers trust us to deliver results that not only improve their home’s appearance but also protect their investment.

Garage Door Painting

A well-painted garage door can add to your home’s curb appeal. We’ll ensure your garage door blends seamlessly with the rest of your home’s exterior.

Decks, Porch & Fences

We offer staining and painting services for decks, porches, and fences that protect the wood while enhancing its natural beauty.

Stucco Painting & Repair

Stucco is a durable exterior material, but it can crack or fade over time. Our team can repair any damage and give your stucco a fresh coat of paint to restore its appearance and durability.

Siding Painting

Whether your home has wood, vinyl, or aluminum siding, we have the experience to give it a fresh new look. We ensure smooth, even coverage that enhances your home’s appearance.

Caulking and Texture

We provide caulking and texture services to seal gaps, protect your home from moisture, and create a smooth surface for painting.

Other Services
